svg.aria-label: Deploying and releasing are separate events. The deploy puts the same artefact on every server at once. The release opens the feature to one per cent, then ten, then everyone, by flipping a flag. Flag-off stops new exposure after propagation; in-flight work and persisted effects need separate recovery.
svg.text: TWO EVENTS PEOPLE TREAT AS ONE
